claim_one_line: THE FRAME'S EXACT ZEROS, DERIVED (P-262, P-268; no data): det(sum u_s E_s*) = 1/4 sum u_s^2 and the residue matrix has rank one for every twist (sum R_s^2 = 0, by theta_1's quasi-period), so det M = 1/4 sum c_s R_s^2, independent of L -- the reason B1703's protection is leading-order only; the coupling is Y_ab = sum m_s [C_a^-1 S C_b]_s, so with S = C_p and m_p = 0 it is a signed cross product with spectrum (|w|, |w|, 0), and R_p* = 0 on all 27 tied lines: B1701's 0 : 1 : 1 derived; and D = sum c_s R_s^2 vanishes exactly when the left twist has exact order 4 and the right twist order <= 2 (the involution u -> -u pairs the four channels), on every line of order 1-12 -- the law read from order 12 that predicted B1713's order-4 lines before they were read. 0 of 19.
